model_annotation: The chart illustrates CoLeC-E performance (in percent) for three LLaMA-2 model sizes under four supervised fine-tuning (SFT) dataset conditions. The horizontal axis contains the categorical model labels “LLaMA-2-7B,” “LLaMA-2-13B,” and “LLaMA-2-70B,” arranged left to right, and within each model category there is a group of four adjacent bars. The vertical axis is labeled “CoLeC-E (%)” and uses a linear scale from 0 up to about 50, with evenly spaced tick marks at 10-point intervals (0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50). In each group, the first bar corresponds to “no SFT” (light blue with diagonal hatch) with approximate values of about 4% for 7B, about 9% for 13B, and about 26–27% for 70B; the second bar corresponds to “+ SFT on D₀” (light orange with horizontal hatch) at about 20% (7B), about 32% (13B), and about 45% (70B); the third bar corresponds to “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” (light purple with diagonal hatch) at about 28% (7B), about 37% (13B), and about 49–50% (70B); and the fourth bar corresponds to “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” (salmon/pink solid fill) at about 30% (7B), about 39% (13B), and about 50–51% (70B). A legend in the upper-left maps these four conditions to their colors and hatch patterns, the bars are not displayed in a descending or ascending sort by height, and no individual bars appear specially emphasized beyond the distinct color/hatching encodings.
